base.approval_evidence: User requested: I want three variants of this type. Switch up where he has armor, give one a 2 handed sword, vary their skin tones slightly and make sure they have distint faces. use the skill

variants.differences: Desaturated olive-gray skin, broad square face and blunt nose, bare head, shoulder/forearm armor, two-handed sword
variants.prompt: Create exactly ONE full-body goblin variant, transparent PNG, same art family as the supplied approved base B1. Image 1 is the approved identity-family, proportions, scale, palette and rendering reference; image 2 is the RuneSpeak graphic style reference. Preserve the base's compact sturdy goblin body proportions, big ears, serious gritty mood, shallow three-quarter view facing viewer LEFT. Distinct individual face is required, not merely recoloring the base. Crisp 2D cel shading, broad flat colors with hard-edged shadows and minimal graphic highlights, slate iron, brown leather and faded oxblood accents, sparse bold chips. No realism, gradients, painterly textures, PBR, fine scratches, intricate details, cute smiling mascot. Neutral combat-ready stance with separated feet and coherent grips. Full silhouette including ears, feet and weapon fully inside square canvas, ample transparent padding. Consistent character body height across variants; weapon may occupy padding. No text, labels, ground shadow or scenery. VARIANT V1 revision 1: GREATSWORD BRUISER. Slightly desaturated gray-green skin. DISTINCT FACE: broad square jaw, short flattened blunt nose, small close-set amber eyes below a heavy straight brow, thick lower lip with two short wide tusks; no diagonal eye scar. Bare bald head, NO helmet. Armor layout: two compact unequal shoulder plates, heavy iron forearm guards and plain leather vest, NO metal breastplate, NO knee plates, leather boots. One simple horizontal cheek scar. ONE large straight two-handed sword with a broad chipped blade, long leather-wrapped two-hand grip and short crossguard. BOTH HANDS visibly wrap the SAME hilt, one above the other, the blade extends diagonally up toward upper left, clear of his face, all in frame. No shield, no additional weapons. Preserve animation-friendly elbows and wrist structure.

construction.parts: Root/pelvis, torso, head/ears/headgear, paired upper/lower arms/hands and legs/boots; armor follows corresponding limb; tabard secondary motion.
construction.v1: Two-hand grip constrains both wrists to common sword hilt; shoulder plates and forearm armor need clearance. Different attack motion from one-hand variants.
construction.v2: Shield attached to left forearm; preserve hooked nose silhouette, tusk asymmetry, shin armor.
construction.v3: Separate blade attachments in both hands; maintain one-sided shoulder/knee armor.

limitations: No separated layers, rig, animation or runtime export yet.
Display comparison uses approximate body-height alignment; animation canvas and anchors remain to be measured.
